note: Set B binds every value to the correct mission concept and property with no misreadings, while Set A mixes in garbled entities ('n-axis telescope', 'axis telescope'), misbinds Lynx's 10 m focal length as a mirror-assembly 'dimension'/'diameter', and attributes the science-instrument counts to the mirror assembly or a bare 'spacecraft' instead of the mission. remarks: Both sets miss Origins' three science instruments; Set B also drops LUVOIR-A's 15 m diameter, LUVOIR-B's three instruments and HabEx's four instruments (Set A covers the latter only under the vague entity 'spacecraft').
